title: Wellington College International School Bangkok — claimed by thegentlemen
description: TH · Education · wellingtoncollege.ac.th Wellington College Bangkok is a British international school for ages 2 to 18, opened in 2018 as part of Wellington College UK, with around 1100 students on a 28 acre campus in eastern Bangkok.
